verdict.rationale: YYLO is documented as a CLI orchestrator requiring `npm install -g @yylo/cli` plus explicit `yylo init`/`task start` workflows that freeze SHAs, create worktrees, and hydrate dependencies — this is CLI-based setup, not a one-click repo-access grant. No evidence describes a GitHub App-style one-click install or OAuth flow for repo access. Missing for 10: any one-click install/authorization mechanism, evidence of simplified non-CLI onboarding, or a hosted install button.
